change.title: Add the Science Runtime Adoption Record
change.summary: Adds a private bounded source-only Science adoption ledger that compares validated executable predecessor/candidate observations, records deferred, rejected, and selected decisions, advances exact launch/finalize milestones, retains active compensation references, and binds new managed-launch receipt V2 provenance while retaining read-only V1 compatibility. Healthy Science is never restarted only to adopt a candidate, and no real Science user data or credentials are inspected.

basis: focused Rust tests cover decisions and milestones, receipt-only recovery without premature finalize, exact binding provenance, fresh V2 runtime hydration, and invalid-receipt compaction fail-closed behavior
focused Rust tests also cover compensation-only retention, V2 exact cleanup, V1 read compatibility, private bounded storage, and path/user-data exclusion
selected dedupe reuses only the latest matching attempt; A-B-A appends a new B-A attempt while same-runtime restart and unfinished retry reuse the current attempt
the production preflight records validated candidate observations while healthy Science remains running and only selects an adoption attempt on the normal stopped-to-started path
fresh finalize replay requires the same attempt id in action, binding, current V2 receipt, and hydrated runtime before cleanup or commit; preflight requires receipt/runtime/binding equality
bounded compaction retains finalized attempts referenced only by runtime binding as well as live receipt, transaction, or active compensation references

the production one-click fixture changes the validated candidate under a healthy managed Science, invokes production preflight, observes deferred_healthy, and proves the exact PID, owner, and serve count remain unchanged
canonical source-gate and clean-context independent review evidence are required before this change is accepted
no real Science account, organization, conversation, project, environment, credential, Keychain, SSH private key, installed App, provider, signing, or public-release validation is claimed
